title: Potato and Carrot Pancakes with Herb Sour Cream
blurb: Crisp little pancakes made from grated potato and carrot, served with a simple herb-topped sour cream.
steps: Peel the potatoes and carrots, then coarsely grate them into a large bowl.
Squeeze handfuls of the grated vegetables firmly over the sink to remove as much liquid as possible, then return them to the bowl.
Finely slice the spring onions and add them to the bowl along with the eggs, flour, salt and pepper, then mix everything together well.
Heat a little oil in a large frying pan over medium heat.
Drop heaped tablespoons of the mixture into the pan, flattening each one slightly with the back of the spoon, and cook for about three minutes on each side until golden and crisp.
Finely chop the chives and stir them through the soured cream.
Serve the pancakes warm with the herb soured cream on the side.
